K1_computational.T_prep: sample selection, scaler fit on the sample, transform of sample and probe
K1_computational.T_kernel: Nystrom: C = K[:,L]; exact: full Gram
K1_computational.T_operator_or_buildH: Nystrom: TwinOperatorSPD builds; exact: build_problem (S/M assembly, LU, long-double refinement, H)
K1_computational.T_train: sum of method stages excluding load/prep (None if a stage is missing; never inferred)

K2_memory.peak_rss: max over phases of VmHWM after writing 5 to /proc/self/clear_refs at phase start; cross-check ru_maxrss
K2_memory.major_arrays: maximum array size and shape from object inventory at checkpoints

K3_solver: per twin: status, HVP total and category counts, r_inf, gap_rel, gap, dual objective, CG-cap events (phaseB_exit_cap), CG infeasible steps, zero-curvature events, gradient/verification refresh events, phase counts
K4_spectrum: m, r, n_positive(W), n_negative(W), n_zero(W), tau_W, min/max retained |lambda|, unique/duplicate landmark predictor vectors, cond(B), cond(A) (diagnostics)

K6_raw_function_fidelity.where: only N=2000 and N=4000 (exact reference exists); each Nystrom configuration separately vs exact; f_plus and f_minus separately
K6_raw_function_fidelity.pearson: NA if either vector has zero variance

interpretation_rule: no 'better'/'worse' wording before results; quantitative differences only; function fidelity to exact is claimed only at N=2000,4000; for N>4000 use kernel-pair diagnostics and resource/convergence behavior
aggregation: per (N,m) across seeds: median and IQR for time/memory, mean +/- SD for fidelity, all seed values retained; no significance tests
